about.title: From Northern Kenya to UoN School of Medicine.
about.lead: Training to heal individuals in the clinic while organizing systems that serve thousands on campus and back home.
about.bio: Abdikhaliq Abdi (SG_AKASH) is a Medical Student (MBChB) at the University of Nairobi School of Medicine, Head of Public Service at the UNSA Council, former UNSA Chief of Staff (2025), and former Secretary General of the Association of Medical Students of the University of Nairobi (AMSUN, 2024). Guided by both bedside discipline and public accountability, his work links student welfare policy with grassroots educational mentorship across Northern Kenya.

chapters.heading: Origins & Resilience
chapters.text: Growing up with first-hand awareness of the educational gaps in Northern Kenya forged a lasting commitment: reaching the university gate is never the finish line—it is the obligation to hold that door open for the next student.

chapters.heading: Medical Training at UoN
chapters.text: Studying Medicine & Surgery (MBChB) at the University of Nairobi sharpened both analytical rigor and empathy—knowing that wellbeing depends as much on housing, dignity, and access as on clinical care.

chapters.heading: Why Public Service
chapters.text: Serving as AMSUN Secretary General, UNSA Chief of Staff, and now UNSA Head of Public Service proved that principled dialogue backed by organized student solidarity moves institutions.

leadership.philosophyText: I believe leadership is not about holding a title, but about using your position to serve others and create tangible, positive change. At the University of Nairobi, I have had the honor of serving in various capacities, always with the goal of improving the student experience.

positions.focus: Leading student public service initiatives, campus welfare escalation, and administrative accountability across University of Nairobi faculties.
Directed executive coordination, council policy execution, and cross-campus communication within the student government.
Represented medical students in the Association of Medical Students of the University of Nairobi, advancing clinical welfare and academic advocacy.

achievements.title: Championed a 50% Reduction in Hostel Fees
achievements.text: Led a successful campaign, including negotiations with the university administration and peaceful demonstrations, that reduced hostel fees by half across University of Nairobi residences.

achievements.title: Executive Coordination & Student Welfare Delivery
achievements.text: From UNSA Council Chief of Staff (2025) to Head of Public Service today, streamlined grievance resolution channels and strengthened student-to-administration accountability.

achievements.title: Clinical Representation at AMSUN School of Medicine
achievements.text: As Secretary General of AMSUN in 2024, championed clinical rotation schedules, academic welfare representation, and peer medical student unity at Kenyatta National Hospital campus.

initiatives.title: What I Offer: Community Empowerment & Mentorship
initiatives.text: Recognizing the challenges I overcame, I founded a Community-Based Organization (CBO) dedicated to empowering the education sector across Kenya, with a special focus on Northern Kenya. My CBO runs mentorship programs for both primary and secondary school students, providing them with the guidance, encouragement, and resources they need to excel academically and in life.

pillars.title: Primary School Foundations
pillars.detail: Early literacy encouragement, study habits, and role-model visibility in underserved classrooms.

pillars.title: Secondary Exam & Career Guidance
pillars.detail: Subject selection, KCSE preparation workshops, and pathways into medicine, STEM, and public leadership.

pillars.title: Resource Mobilization
pillars.detail: Connecting learning materials, university peer mentors, and community support directly to schools.
